root.label: Met pauses rejected overseas Fayed trafficking referrals

events.label: Met pauses rejected overseas Fayed trafficking referrals

slots.name: referral status
slots.sentence: A Met police spokesperson said: “We were previously making referrals to the Home Office for victims living in the UK and abroad, but those relating to victims living abroad were being rejected. As a result, we have paused any further such referrals. Should the Home Office position change, we will restart those submissions. Our support to victims continues, regardless of where they live.”
